security: Variable Rate MuniFund Term Preferred Shares, Series 2020-1
footnote_text: The 3,800 variable rate munifund term preferred shares reported as disposed of in Table I represent variable rate munifund term preferred shares, Series 2020-1 (the "VMTP Shares") indirectly beneficially owned by JPMorgan Chase Bank, National Association ("JPMCB") through the J.P. Morgan PUTTERs/DRIVERs, Series 5055 Trust. The VMTP Shares were disposed of as a result of a redemption by the Issuer for a redemption price of $50,089.37790 per share (which includes a liquidation preference of $50,000.00 per share and accrued dividends of $89.37790 per share).
